name: Hide My Tweets on X.com
description: Hide tweets from specified users on X.com.

data_collection_permissions.description: Collects necessary data to hide tweets from specified users on X.com.

personallyIdentifyingInfo.description: Saves the list of muted users (which you provide as settings) using Firefox Sync (storage.sync).

browsingActivity.description: Reads the current tab's URL (tabs, webNavigation) to determine when to apply the mute rules.
